name: Qinchuan Precision Transmission
name_zh: 陕西秦川高精传动科技有限公司
summary: Shaanxi Qinchuan Precision Transmission Technology is the wholly owned Qinchuan Machine Tool & Tool Group subsidiary responsible for RV robot-joint reducers. Established at the end of 2022 with the group’s reducer operating assets, it develops, manufactures and sells precision transmission components. Its portfolio continues Qinchuan’s earlier robot-reducer business.
